t: 英格兰的詹姆斯二世和苏格兰的七世在他弟弟查理二世去世后被封为国王.
te: James II of England and VII of Scotland is proclaimed King upon the death of his brother Charles II.
dz: 英格兰的詹姆斯二世和苏格兰的七世在他弟弟查理二世去世后被封为国王.
de: James II of England and VII of Scotland is proclaimed King upon the death of his brother Charles II.

t: 勒内-罗伯特·卡维利埃在马塔戈尔达建立圣路易斯堡 Bay因此成为了法国对德克萨斯的主张的基础.
te: René-Robert Cavelier establishes Fort St. Louis at Matagorda Bay thus forming the basis for France's claim to Texas.
dz: 勒内-罗伯特·卡维利埃在马塔戈尔达建立圣路易斯堡 Bay因此成为了法国对德克萨斯的主张的基础.
de: René-Robert Cavelier establishes Fort St. Louis at Matagorda Bay thus forming the basis for France's claim to Texas.

t: 叛军和奥斯曼军队之间的弗尔蒂耶利卡战役.
te: Battle of Vrtijeljka between rebels and Ottoman forces.
dz: 叛军和奥斯曼军队之间的弗尔蒂耶利卡战役.
de: Battle of Vrtijeljka between rebels and Ottoman forces.

t: 詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott, Duke of Monmouth)与忠诚的追随者一起…
te: James Scott, Duke of Monmouth, lands at Lyme in Dorset with loyal followers with the intent to depose king James II of …
dz: 詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott, Duke of Monmouth)与忠诚的追随者一起登陆多尔塞特的莱姆,意图废黜英格兰国王詹姆斯二世.
de: James Scott, Duke of Monmouth, lands at Lyme in Dorset with loyal followers with the intent to depose king James II of England.

t: 詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott) 第1任蒙茅斯公爵在布里奇沃特宣布自己为英格兰国王.
te: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth declares himself King of England at Bridgwater.
dz: 蒙茅斯起义:詹姆斯·斯科特(James Scott) 第1任蒙茅斯公爵在布里奇沃特宣布自己为英格兰国王.
de: Monmouth Rebellion: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth declares himself King of England at Bridgwater.

t: 蒙茅斯起义的最后一战. 詹姆斯二世国王的军队击败了蒙茅斯第一公爵詹姆斯·斯科特的军队.
te: Last battle of the Monmouth Rebellion. Troops of King James II defeat troops of James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth.
dz: 刺客之战:蒙茅斯起义的最后一战. 詹姆斯二世国王的军队击败了蒙茅斯第一公爵詹姆斯·斯科特的军队.
de: Battle of Sedgemoor: Last battle of the Monmouth Rebellion. Troops of King James II defeat troops of James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth.

t: 49天围攻克龙以威尼斯人投降并屠杀其驻防地而结束.
te: The 49-day Siege of Coron ends with the surrender and massacre of its garrison by the Venetians.
dz: 莫兰战争:49天围攻克龙以威尼斯人投降并屠杀其驻防地而结束.
de: Morean War: The 49-day Siege of Coron ends with the surrender and massacre of its garrison by the Venetians.

t: 洛林的查尔斯手下的帝国联军击败了一直围困着艾斯克特戈姆的奥斯曼军队.
te: An imperial coalition army under Charles of Lorraine defeats the Ottoman army that had been besieging Esztergom.
dz: 大土耳其战争:洛林的查尔斯手下的帝国联军击败了一直围困着艾斯克特戈姆的奥斯曼军队.
de: Great Turkish War: An imperial coalition army under Charles of Lorraine defeats the Ottoman army that had been besieging Esztergom.

t: 喀拉马塔战役以威尼斯人战胜卡普丹帕夏统治下的奥斯曼帝国军队而结束.
te: the Battle of Kalamata ends in a Venetian victory over the forces of the Ottoman Empire under the Kapudan Pasha.
dz: 莫兰战争:喀拉马塔战役以威尼斯人战胜卡普丹帕夏统治下的奥斯曼帝国军队而结束.
de: Morean War: the Battle of Kalamata ends in a Venetian victory over the forces of the Ottoman Empire under the Kapudan Pasha.
